title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
description: On a desert planet, a young nobleman becomes entangled in a struggle over a rare spice, political betrayal, and a prophecy that could reshape the galaxy.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: A witty young woman and a proud, wealthy gentleman must overcome first impressions and social expectations in Regency-era England.

title: The Hobbit
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: A comfort-loving homebody is swept into a quest with dwarves to reclaim a treasure guarded by a dragon.

title: Klara and the Sun
author: Kazuo Ishiguro
description: An artificial friend observes the human world with devotion, questioning what it means to love and be loved.

title: Gone Girl
author: Gillian Flynn
description: When a woman vanishes on her anniversary, her husband becomes the prime suspect in a twisting tale of secrets and deception.

title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
description: A practical guide to building good habits and breaking bad ones through small, consistent daily changes.
